description: This file contains shell functions related to firmware upgrade operations for the Linksys device in the OpenWrt project, including determining the target firmware partition and performing the platform-specific upgrade process.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the current firmware partition and toggles to the other partition for upgrade, based on UBI environment and system state.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process, including handling different magic values, mounting and unmounting UBI volumes, and executing the upgrade tarball.
